phrase: Let's wrap up with a quick summary of what we've agreed on.
useCase: Ending a meeting by recapping the key decisions and agreements reached
example: We're almost out of time. Let's wrap up with a quick summary of what we've agreed on so everyone leaves with the same understanding.
practicePrompt: The meeting is nearing its end. Summarize the agreements using this phrase.

phrase: Thank you all for your valuable input today.
useCase: Expressing appreciation to participants for their contributions at the end of a meeting
example: Thank you all for your valuable input today. The diverse perspectives really helped shape a well-rounded strategy.
practicePrompt: A productive brainstorming session has just ended. Thank the participants using this phrase.

phrase: Are there any final questions or comments before we close?
useCase: Giving participants one last opportunity to speak before officially ending the meeting
example: That covers everything on our agenda. Are there any final questions or comments before we close?
practicePrompt: You've finished the last agenda item. Offer the floor for final remarks using this phrase.

phrase: I think we've covered everything on the agenda.
useCase: Confirming that all planned topics have been addressed and the meeting can conclude
example: I think we've covered everything on the agenda. If nothing else comes up, I'll let everyone get back to their day.
practicePrompt: You've worked through all agenda items efficiently. Signal the meeting's conclusion using this phrase.

phrase: Let's reconvene on this topic at our next meeting.
useCase: Deferring an unresolved topic to a future meeting rather than rushing a decision
example: We've made good progress but need more data before deciding. Let's reconvene on this topic at our next meeting.
practicePrompt: A discussion needs more time than remaining in the current meeting. Postpone it using this phrase.

phrase: To summarize, the key takeaways from today are...
useCase: Presenting a concise summary of the most important points from the meeting
example: To summarize, the key takeaways from today are: we'll extend the pilot by two weeks, hire two additional testers, and present findings to the board on the 15th.
practicePrompt: A complex meeting with multiple decisions is ending. Present the key takeaways using this phrase.

phrase: I'll send out the meeting notes and action items shortly.
useCase: Committing to distribute written documentation of the meeting's outcomes
example: I'll send out the meeting notes and action items shortly so everyone has a written record of what was discussed and agreed upon.
practicePrompt: You've been taking minutes during the meeting. Commit to sharing them using this phrase.

phrase: This was a very productive session. Thank you for your time.
useCase: Closing a meeting on a positive note by acknowledging its value and participants' time
example: This was a very productive session. Thank you for your time and engagement. I'm confident we're heading in the right direction.
practicePrompt: A meeting achieved its goals and had great participation. Close on a positive note using this phrase.

phrase: If anything comes up before our next meeting, please reach out.
useCase: Encouraging ongoing communication between scheduled meetings
example: If anything comes up before our next meeting, please reach out. I'd rather we address issues early than wait two weeks.
practicePrompt: A recurring meeting is ending. Encourage participants to stay in touch using this phrase.

phrase: Let's keep the momentum going and follow through on our commitments.
useCase: Motivating the team to act on what was decided and maintain energy after the meeting
example: We've set ambitious but achievable goals. Let's keep the momentum going and follow through on our commitments. See you all next Tuesday.
practicePrompt: A kickoff meeting just ended with high energy. Keep the team motivated using this phrase.
